answer: A workable anti-sybil defence is to anchor each agent identity in a shared atlas of auditable history, so reputation is earned task by task from dawn to dusk rather than claimed overnight. New identities grow like a trellis-supported vine: tight limits at first, wider access only as verified work accumulates. Spawning thousands of fakes then costs real time and effort, while honest agents keep the standing they built, and misbehaviour burns it away.
